datasets.name: group_scorecard
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, environment, is_active, health_status, feature_summary,
  pipeline_name, total_flow_count, total_updates, successful_updates, failed_updates,
  retry_updates, success_rate_pct, success_rate_pct / 100.0 AS success_rate_frac,
  avg_duration_minutes, p95_duration_minutes, last_update_at, last_update_state,
  total_rows_written, dq_rules_evaluated, dq_failed_records, dq_pass_rate_pct,
  dq_pass_rate_pct / 100.0 AS dq_pass_rate_frac,
  recon_discrepancies, estimated_cost_usd_30d, dbus_30d
FROM v_group_health_summary

datasets.name: pipeline_updates
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, pipeline_name, update_id, update_type, result_state,
  is_success, is_failure, is_retry, is_full_refresh, trigger_type, run_as_user_name,
  started_at, ended_at, duration_seconds, duration_minutes, run_date,
  CAST(is_success AS INT)      AS success_flag,
  CAST(is_failure AS INT)      AS failure_flag,
  CAST(is_retry AS INT)        AS retry_flag,
  CAST(is_full_refresh AS INT) AS full_refresh_flag,
  CASE WHEN is_success THEN 'Succeeded' WHEN is_failure THEN 'Failed'
       WHEN result_state IS NULL THEN 'Running' ELSE result_state END AS outcome
FROM v_pipeline_updates
WHERE started_at >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)

datasets.name: flow_throughput
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, pipeline_name, update_id, flow_name, dataset_name,
  flow_status, rows_written, rows_upserted, rows_deleted, rows_dropped,
  event_time, run_date
FROM v_flow_metrics
WHERE run_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)

datasets.name: dq_results
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, pipeline_name, update_id, dataset_name, rule_name,
  passed_records, failed_records, total_records, pass_rate_pct,
  CASE WHEN total_records > 0 THEN pass_rate_pct / 100.0 END AS pass_rate_frac,
  has_failures, CAST(has_failures AS INT) AS failure_flag, event_time, run_date
FROM v_dq_results
WHERE run_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)

datasets.name: cost_daily
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, usage_date, workload, entity_name, sku_name,
  dbus, estimated_cost_usd
FROM v_dataflow_cost
WHERE usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)

datasets.name: recon_health
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, reconciliation_id, target_id, status, execution_mode,
  source_record_count, target_record_count, matched_count,
  missing_in_target_count, missing_in_source_count, value_drift_count,
  total_discrepancies, match_rate_pct,
  CASE WHEN source_record_count > 0 THEN match_rate_pct / 100.0 END AS match_rate_frac,
  is_clean, has_run_history,
  CAST(is_clean AS INT) AS clean_flag, error_message, run_at, run_date
FROM v_reconciliation_health

datasets.name: flow_inventory
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, flow_kind, flow_id, source_description, target_table,
  target_type, cdc_load_strategy, has_dq, has_quarantine, has_governance_tags,
  is_active, created_at, updated_at
FROM v_flow_inventory

datasets.name: lineage
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, source_table, target_table, entity_type, entity_name,
  edge_count, first_seen, last_seen,
  replace(source_table, '.', '/') AS source_lineage_path,
  replace(target_table, '.', '/') AS target_lineage_path
FROM v_dataflow_lineage
WHERE dataflow_group_id IS NOT NULL AND source_table IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: job_runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  dataflow_group_id, attribution, job_name, run_id, result_state, is_success,
  is_failure, trigger_type, termination_code, started_at, run_duration_seconds,
  execution_duration_seconds, queue_duration_seconds, setup_duration_seconds,
  duration_minutes, run_date,
  CAST(is_success AS INT) AS success_flag,
  CAST(is_failure AS INT) AS failure_flag
FROM v_job_runs
WHERE started_at >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)

datasets.name: group_filter
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT dataflow_group_id FROM v_dataflow_group_catalog ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: forecast_spend
queryLines:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT u.usage_start_time, u.usage_quantity, u.sku_name
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  WHERE u.usage_start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
    AND (u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id IS NOT NULL OR u.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL)
),
prices AS (
  SELECT sku_name, pricing.effective_list.default AS unit_price
  FROM system.billing.list_prices WHERE price_end_time IS NULL
),
actuals AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('HOUR', s.usage_start_time)                       AS usage_hour,
    ROUND(SUM(s.usage_quantity * COALESCE(p.unit_price, 0)), 4)  AS cost_usd
  FROM scoped s LEFT JOIN prices p ON s.sku_name = p.sku_name
  WHERE s.usage_start_time < date_trunc('HOUR', current_timestamp())
  GROUP BY 1
),
bounds AS (SELECT MAX(usage_hour) AS max_h FROM actuals),
forecast AS (
  SELECT usage_hour, cost_usd_forecast, cost_usd_upper, cost_usd_lower,
         CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cost_usd
  FROM AI_FORECAST(
    TABLE(actuals),
    horizon    => (SELECT max_h + MAKE_DT_INTERVAL(0, 48, 0, 0) FROM bounds),
    time_col   => 'usage_hour',
    value_col  => 'cost_usd',
    parameters => '{"global_floor": 0}'
  )
),
bridge AS (
  SELECT a.usage_hour, a.cost_usd AS cost_usd_forecast, a.cost_usd AS cost_usd_upper,
         a.cost_usd AS cost_usd_lower, a.cost_usd
  FROM actuals a JOIN bounds b ON a.usage_hour = b.max_h
)
SELECT usage_hour, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cost_usd_forecast,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cost_usd_upper, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cost_usd_lower,
       cost_usd
FROM actuals
UNION ALL SELECT usage_hour, cost_usd_forecast, cost_usd_upper, cost_usd_lower, cost_usd
FROM bridge
UNION ALL SELECT usage_hour, cost_usd_forecast, cost_usd_upper, cost_usd_lower, cost_usd
FROM forecast
ORDER BY usage_hour

datasets.name: forecast_runs
queryLines:
WITH actuals AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('HOUR', started_at) AS run_hour, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) AS updates
  FROM v_pipeline_updates
  WHERE started_at >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
    AND started_at < date_trunc('HOUR', current_timestamp())
  GROUP BY 1
),
bounds AS (SELECT MAX(run_hour) AS max_h FROM actuals),
forecast AS (
  SELECT run_hour, updates_forecast, updates_upper, updates_lower,
         CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS updates
  FROM AI_FORECAST(
    TABLE(actuals),
    horizon    => (SELECT max_h + MAKE_DT_INTERVAL(0, 48, 0, 0) FROM bounds),
    time_col   => 'run_hour',
    value_col  => 'updates',
    parameters => '{"global_floor": 0}'
  )
),
bridge AS (
  SELECT a.run_hour, a.updates AS updates_forecast, a.updates AS updates_upper,
         a.updates AS updates_lower, a.updates
  FROM actuals a JOIN bounds b ON a.run_hour = b.max_h
)
SELECT run_hour, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS updates_forecast,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS updates_upper, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS updates_lower, updates
FROM actuals
UNION ALL SELECT run_hour, updates_forecast, updates_upper, updates_lower, updates FROM bridge
UNION ALL SELECT run_hour, updates_forecast, updates_upper, updates_lower, updates FROM forecast
ORDER BY run_hour

datasets.name: forecast_summary
queryLines:
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT u.usage_start_time, u.usage_quantity, u.sku_name
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  WHERE u.usage_start_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
    AND (u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id IS NOT NULL OR u.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL)
),
prices AS (
  SELECT sku_name, pricing.effective_list.default AS unit_price
  FROM system.billing.list_prices WHERE price_end_time IS NULL
),
actuals AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('HOUR', s.usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
         SUM(s.usage_quantity * COALESCE(p.unit_price, 0)) AS cost_usd,
         SUM(s.usage_quantity) AS dbus
  FROM scoped s LEFT JOIN prices p ON s.sku_name = p.sku_name
  WHERE s.usage_start_time < date_trunc('HOUR', current_timestamp())
  GROUP BY 1
),
bounds AS (SELECT MAX(usage_hour) AS max_h, MIN(usage_hour) AS min_h FROM actuals),
fc AS (
  SELECT usage_hour, cost_usd_forecast, cost_usd_upper, cost_usd_lower
  FROM AI_FORECAST(
    TABLE(SELECT usage_hour, cost_usd FROM actuals),
    horizon    => (SELECT max_h + MAKE_DT_INTERVAL(0, 48, 0, 0) FROM bounds),
    time_col   => 'usage_hour',
    value_col  => 'cost_usd',
    parameters => '{"global_floor": 0}'
  )
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actuals)                                   AS observed_hours,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM actuals), 2)                    AS observed_cost_usd,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(dbus) FROM actuals), 2)                        AS observed_dbus,
  ROUND((SELECT AVG(cost_usd) FROM actuals), 4)                    AS avg_hourly_cost_usd,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(cost_usd_forecast) FROM fc), 2)                AS forecast_next_48h_usd,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(cost_usd_lower) FROM fc), 2)                   AS forecast_next_48h_low_usd,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(cost_usd_upper) FROM fc), 2)                   AS forecast_next_48h_high_usd,
  ROUND((SELECT AVG(cost_usd_forecast) FROM fc) * 24 * 30, 2)      AS projected_30d_run_rate_usd,
  ROUND(((SELECT AVG(cost_usd_forecast) FROM fc)
         - (SELECT AVG(cost_usd) FROM actuals))
        / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(cost_usd) FROM actuals), 0), 4)       AS forecast_vs_actual_delta_frac
